ORDINANCE A 6934
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
SECTION 1. That the Chicago Zoning Ordinance be amended by changing all the C2-3, Motor
Vehicle-Related Commercial District and M1-3 Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District
symbols and indications on Map Number 6-E in the area bounded by:

a line 201.82 feet north of and parallel to East 26" Street; the alley next east of and
parallel to South State Street; a line 128 feet south of and parallel to East 26" Street;

and South State Street
to those of a RM5, Residential Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective upon its passage.

PatDowel————_____
Alderman, 3% Ward
